messages.security.notice.desc: Third-party plugins run in a separate JVM by default and can publish only supported declarative contributions through a bounded inter-process protocol. The worker still uses the application's operating-system account, so it is not a complete OS sandbox. Plugins marked "Fully trusted in-process" run in the application's JVM with full host permissions. A signature proves publisher identity and content integrity only; it is not a security review. Install only plugins you trust.
